items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was thinking about Sidney getting no cabaret, and I gave him a job. You know, I had a job for him with my band... Circle Ballroom.

ctx.x: dance hall. I forgot the name of the place, the hall... Whatever I did down there... Pretty good job... Taxi-dance hall. I think I had a five-piece band down there. And Sidney Bechet... During that time, Sidney Bechet wasn't doing nothing. The whole thing about it is, he got in a little trouble, and he couldn't get no cabaret card, and he couldn't work no place around here.
